build_shape_bias_metric: build a ShapeBiasMetric instance to evaluate model shape bias on the cue_conflict dataset
process_data_samples: process a batch of data samples to extract predictions and ground truth labels for shape bias evaluation
create_csv_results: create a CSV file with headers to store shape bias evaluation results for a model
dump_results_to_csv: dump a list of prediction results to the CSV file with model name and category info
compute_accuracy_metrics: compute top-1 accuracy metrics by comparing predicted categories against ground truth categories
